Press kit · The Center Court Collection
ACE & SMASH · August 2026

Hello Nancy has made a million people come.
Now it's making them sweat.

Hello Nancy is the brand behind Lem, TikTok's number one viral sex toy and a clitoral massager shaped like a lemon. It was built on one very simple idea: give as many people as possible permission to try. Make it cute, make it look like fruit, and suddenly it's something you can leave out, joke about, and give as a gift without anyone getting strange about it.

It isn't just cute. Over a million sold since April 2023, one every 23 seconds, and the reviews are the part that settles it. "The fourth setting briefly opened a wormhole to another dimension." "I'm 32 and just had my first orgasm thanks to the lemon." "I am a fit almost 78 year old, and enjoying sharing my bed with a lemon."

None of which is guesswork. Hello Nancy works with a panel of eleven clinical experts, and has been covered by VICE, Mashable, SheKnows, PopSugar and The Daily Beast.

This month the shelf leaves the produce aisle and goes courtside. The Center Court Collection is two products: ACE, an air-suction massager shaped like a tennis ball, in green or pink, and SMASH, a full-size wand vibrator with a ball for a head. Both land in time for the US Open.

Game. Set. Finish.

The founders

Interview available on request

Momoko Kashiwabara & Rahul Ramchand

"I was always curious. I was also always too shy to do anything about it."

That's where Nancy started. I'd never really used one. I'd think about it, read about it, and then never actually do anything, mostly because everything on the market looked like something I'd have to hide.

So my husband and I made the version I would have bought. Not bold, not clinical. Discreet enough to sit on a shelf without anyone knowing what it was. Which is how we ended up with a lemon. Then an avocado. Then a raspberry.

It's a category nobody has given much love to, and the conversation around it is still whispered. We'd rather it were fun, safe and shame-free, so people actually have it. Including the ones who, like me, were never going to walk into a shop and ask.

— Momoko Kashiwabara, co-founder. Hello Nancy launched April 2023; over a million sold since.
